name: test_group_inheritance_and_no_grant
what: A member of a child group reads the parent group's namespace, and a person with an expired grant gets 403

name: test_agent_never_exceeds_its_human
what: An agent never gets more rights than its person and the token ceiling: finance is closed and it cannot confirm

name: test_classification_filter
what: A level 2 record is invisible to a person with clearance 1 in search, list and stats

name: test_cannot_write_above_clearance
what: A record with classification above the author's clearance is refused with 400

name: test_tenant_isolation
what: Another organization is closed both ways, and a missing namespace answers with the same 403 as another one's

name: test_export_owner_only
what: Export from an outside address is available to the namespace owner; the curator gets 403

name: test_recall_layers
what: Layered search covers only namespaces where the person has a valid grant

name: test_no_evidence_400
what: A record without evidence is refused with bad_request and is not stored

name: test_no_kind_and_bad_kind_400
what: a record without a kind, with an unknown kind or with a kind of another namespace is refused with 400

name: test_fields_stored_as_sent
what: kind, subject, tags, importance and text are stored exactly as the client sent them

name: test_quote_limit
what: A quote longer than 200 characters is refused with 400

name: test_auth
what: no token or a wrong token gives 401, another namespace 403

name: test_admin_only_local
what: The admin token works only from localhost: from an outside address, export gives 403

name: test_initial_strength_owner_bonus
what: A record of importance 2 starts at strength 0.55, and at 0.65 from the owner's words

name: test_independent_vs_repeat
what: three independent pieces of evidence give more strength than one, five repeats less than one independent

name: test_decay_with_clock
what: In 30 days an episode loses half its strength, while a decision, a pinned record and an open commitment do not decay

name: test_used_helpful
what: A used mark reinforces strength by 0.15 of the remainder to 1 and is written as an event in the record history

name: test_slot_candidate_and_contested
what: A new slot value from a third party's words becomes a candidate, not a replacement

name: test_same_claim_in_slot_reinforces
what: the same person repeated the same claim (the same text in the slot), a confirmation: the evidence is added to the current record, strength grows, no candidate; the same message again changes nothing

name: test_late_old_goes_to_history
what: a late record into a slot with an earlier occurred_at goes straight to history; the current one stays

name: test_explicit_supersede_history_revert
what: an explicit supersedes replaces the record, history shows both, revert brings the old one back to current. supersedes pointing to a non-current record gives 400

name: test_slot_unique_constraint
what: the database does not allow a second current record in a slot: the unique index fires

name: test_external_ref_idempotent
what: writing again with the same external_ref does not create a record, it adds evidence to the existing one

name: test_archive_unarchive
what: an archived record disappears from the list, and after unarchiving is current again with strength 0.30

name: test_purge_no_traces
what: purge deletes the record with its evidence and events

name: test_bulk_forget_requires_confirm
what: bulk deletion requires a filter and by default only counts the records

name: test_recall_tags_rare_token_explain_deterministic
what: search ranks the record with a rare token first, returns the score breakdown and repeats the order

name: test_recall_evidence_and_audience
what: search returns the record with its quote and speaker

name: test_recalled_top5_once_per_day
what: The recalled_top5 event is written at most once a day, even if the record was returned three times

name: test_status_and_stats
what: Status with a wrong key gives 404; with the right key, database state, embedding dimension and counters

name: test_schema_check_rejects_wrong_dim
what: the service refuses to start if the embedding dimension in the database does not match the model

name: test_mcp_auth
what: MCP without a token gives 401, another namespace 403; with its own token the full set of tools is available

name: test_mcp_parity_and_tags
what: search with tags through MCP and through REST gives the same results

name: test_import_dry_run_then_apply
what: import by default only checks the records and names the faulty ones

name: test_contradiction_goes_to_owner
what: deep sleep hands a contradiction without a slot to the owner: a queue item with two quotes and a slot

name: test_review_requires_review_right_and_winner
what: A contradiction decision without a winner gives 400, the queue without the review right 403

name: test_nothing_sensitive_goes_to_llm
what: owner_only and level 3 records never go to the LLM, ordinary records of the same subject do

name: test_invalid_llm_answer_partial
what: non-JSON from the LLM breaks only the contradictions stage: the run is PARTIAL with an alert

name: test_cloud_model_for_sleep_is_refused
what: a cloud model in the sleep settings (either of the two): every model stage fails with a clear error and an alert before anything is sent, since mem has no label dictionary and records would go out without masking

name: test_deep_sleep_without_model_never_calls_a_provider
what: no deep-sleep model configured: the model stages are DISABLED, nothing is sent to any model and no alert is raised, even with an Anthropic key in the settings

name: test_slot_suggestion_accept
what: An accepted slot proposal links the records: the newer stays current, the older goes to history

name: test_bad_indices_skip_item_not_stage
what: The model returned a group with invalid numbers and the stage used to fail for all subjects

name: test_stale_gotcha
what: A weakened gotcha goes to the queue as "stale?"

name: test_summary_passes_g2
what: an episode summary that passes G2 is created as an insight with the evidence of all sources

name: test_summary_distortion_rejected
what: a summary with a distorted date is rejected by G2a and goes to the owner as a merge_suggestion

name: test_commitments_never_summarized
what: commitment mirrors are never summarized: no write_summary request even goes to the LLM

name: test_no_slots_for_episodes
what: Episodes get no slot proposals: no suggest_slots request goes to the LLM and the queue is empty

name: test_deep_dry_run_creates_nothing
what: A dry run of the deep sleep counts the summary but does not create it

name: test_init_creates_person_namespace_and_working_agent
what: init: organization, person, personal namespace and agent; the agent token writes and finds a record; repeating is safe

name: test_alert_goes_to_webhook
what: with MEM_ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL an alert goes out as a POST with JSON {"text": ...}; a failed send does not break the call

name: test_migrations_create_no_people_or_namespaces
what: migrations create no organizations, principals, namespaces or grants; a new install starts with init

name: test_service_admin_is_created_once
what: the service principal admin for MEM_ADMIN_TOKEN is in organization system; calling again changes nothing

name: test_trusted_rule_is_current
what: a rule from a trusted source is current and trusted at once and does not go to the queue

name: test_web_rule_held_until_owner
what: a rule from the web stays an untrusted candidate until the owner decides

name: test_web_rule_owner_accepts
what: after the owner confirms it, a gotcha from the web becomes current and trusted

name: test_untrusted_fact_not_held
what: Facts about people from chats stay as they were (current), only marked untrusted

name: test_trusted_evidence_lifts_trust
what: evidence from the owner's words makes an untrusted fact about a person trusted

name: test_hidden_text_removed_and_flagged
what: invisible characters are cut out of the text on save, and the record gets the flag removed:invisible

name: test_secret_rejected
what: a record with a key in the text or a quote is refused and nothing is stored

name: test_forward_not_independent
what: a forwarded message with the same text does not count as independent evidence

name: test_copypaste_not_independent
what: a copy-paste of someone else's text is not independent evidence, while another person's own words are

name: test_kin_quotes_dont_replace_slot
what: two "independent" quotes of one text are one source; no supersession

name: test_same_id_in_other_tenant_is_conflict
what: a principal with an id that already exists in another organization is a Conflict with both organizations in the text, not a silent clearance update; the existing principal does not change

name: test_init_in_second_tenant_does_not_reach_first
what: init of a second organization with the same person id fails with Conflict and issues no token; the token of the first install still works only in its own namespace

name: test_other_owner_or_kind_is_conflict
what: the same id with another on_behalf_of or another kind is a Conflict; kind and owner do not change

name: test_repeat_with_same_identity_is_safe
what: repeating with the same organization, kind and owner passes and updates clearance and name (re-running an install does not fail)

name: test_on_behalf_of_must_exist_in_same_tenant
what: an agent on behalf of a person from another organization or a missing person is a BadRequest; no principal is created

name: test_namespace_of_other_tenant_or_owner_is_conflict
what: a namespace with an id that already belongs to another organization or owner is a Conflict (otherwise the next grant would open it to someone else); repeating with the same parameters passes

name: test_cli_error_is_message_and_exit_code
what: a failed mem.cli command prints a message to stderr with exit code 1, not a traceback; an install script stops

name: test_check_client_reports_rights_and_exit_code
what: check-client with a token from stdin: rights in the namespace and exit code 0; a token of another organization: "no access" and exit code 1; an unknown token: exit code 1

name: test_forget_by_source_ref
what: forget everything taken from one source fragment by the evidence `source_ref` (including records where it is only one of several evidence items); other records stay; dry run first, then confirm with the exact count; a list instead of a string is 400

name: test_db_level_isolation
what: the database itself limits rows to the namespaces in the request scope; without a scope nothing is visible

name: test_api_scope_follows_token
what: the assistant token gets no records of namespace work, neither by list nor by search

name: test_g1_same_speaker
what: if the speaker changed the time themselves, the light sleep makes the candidate current and the old record history

name: test_g1_third_party_review_then_expire
what: a replacement from a third party's words is not applied; after 14 days a contradiction appears

name: test_g1_second_independent_source
what: a second independent piece of evidence promotes the candidate with ground G1b-independent

name: test_g1_owner_confirm
what: the owner's confirmation promotes a candidate from a third party's words at the next sleep

name: test_g1c_new_evidence_for_current_blocks
what: new evidence for the current record stops the replacement, even from the same speaker

name: test_slot_free_promotes
what: if the slot's current record was archived, the candidate becomes current without confirmation

name: test_dedup_exact
what: an exact duplicate differing in case and spaces merges with the original

name: test_dedup_respects_audience_and_slot
what: the nightly merge of duplicates does not widen the audience or mix slots: same_chat records from different chats, same_chat and shareable, records of different slots stay separate; a duplicate from the same chat merges

name: test_three_estimates_not_merged
what: three estimates and a drawing for one person stay four current records; the light sleep does not merge them

name: test_forget_episode_about_day_83
what: an episode without reinforcement is archived on day 83-85; a decision and a pinned record stay

name: test_used_keeps_alive
what: a fact marked used every 20 days keeps strength above 0.5 for the whole model year; without events it drops below 0.2

name: test_used_recently_blocks_forget
what: a weak episode is not archived until 30 days have passed since the last used; after that it is

name: test_no_equalization_42_canaries
what: over 60 nights the strength of 42 canaries does not level out and does not grow without events

name: test_retention_rules
what: History older than 180 days is archived, the assistant archive older than a year is deleted, work has no auto-deletion

name: test_honest_status_and_alerts
what: an error in promote gives status FAILED, in dedup_exact PARTIAL, and every failure sends an alert

name: test_idempotent_second_run
what: a second light sleep run in a row changes nothing in any stage

name: test_dry_run_changes_nothing
what: A dry run of the sleep counts the changes but does not apply them; a normal run then promotes the candidate

name: test_disabled_stage
what: the forget stage disabled through meta does not run and shows as DISABLED in the report

name: test_sleep_endpoints
what: A manual sleep run is available only to admin from localhost and is a dry run by default; the namespace client sees the report

name: test_delegation_rules
what: an agent acts only on behalf of a member or a group of its own organization

name: test_layers_isolation_matrix
what: a member sees their personal layer and the layers of their groups, but not colleagues' personal ones

name: test_speaker_trust_and_independence
what: a member's words are trusted, an outside participant's are not

name: test_team_rule_needs_curator
what: a rule from a member waits for the layer's curator, while a rule from the curator applies at once

name: test_team_rule_with_slot_waits_for_curator_overnight
what: a member's rule with a slot does not take effect by itself overnight when the slot is empty; it waits for the curator (the hold used to look only at untrusted rules, and the light sleep promoted it as "the slot is free")

name: test_team_rule_into_occupied_slot_waits_and_replaces_on_accept
what: a member's rule into an occupied slot also waits for the curator (a rule_confirm item); gate G1 does not promote it at night; after acceptance it replaces the current one, with one current record in the slot (D-2)

name: test_team_rule_duplicate_of_curator_rule_is_merged_and_item_closed
what: a member proposed a rule (waiting for the curator), then the curator said the same; at night the duplicate merges into the curator's current rule, the duplicate's confirmation item closes, one current record in the slot

name: test_team_rule_explicit_supersedes_waits_for_curator
what: a member cannot replace the curator's rule with an explicit supersedes: their rule becomes a candidate with a confirmation item and the current one stays; after the curator accepts, the replacement happens (also for a rule without a slot)

name: test_expired_rule_candidate_closes_its_item
what: a rule candidate the curator never confirmed is archived after 30 days, and its confirmation item closes the same night (previously only contradiction items were closed)

name: test_promotion_through_curator
what: promoting a personal record to the team layer goes through the curator; the source record does not change

name: test_promotion_auto_and_rule_by_curator
what: in a layer with promotion_auto for topic_fact the promotion applies at once, without the curator

name: test_offboard
what: a member who left loses access at once, their personal layer is closed to everyone, their words in the team stay

name: test_crm_mirror_aliases_and_forget_subject
what: an open CRM deal mirror is trusted and does not decay; after closing it decays

name: test_alert_through_proxy
what: MEM_TG_PROXY=socks5://tgproxy:1080 — the Bot API request goes through that SOCKS5 proxy

name: test_no_proxy_direct
what: without MEM_TG_PROXY the alert goes to Telegram directly

name: test_bad_proxy_never_goes_direct
what: a typo in MEM_TG_PROXY — the Telegram alert is not sent at all (only logged), never around the proxy

name: test_webhook_does_not_use_telegram_proxy
what: the webhook alert goes directly; the Telegram proxy applies only to Telegram

name: test_send_failure_does_not_raise
what: proxy unreachable — the alert does not break the sleep; the log has the error type, not the URL with the token

name: test_socks_support_installed
what: httpx has SOCKS support (socksio) installed, otherwise an alert through the proxy would fail on send

name: test_every_page_has_a_translation_and_links_resolve
what: every user page exists in English and Russian with the same headings and code; all relative links and anchors resolve

name: test_anchor_slugs_follow_github
what: heading anchors are computed the way GitHub does, for Latin and Cyrillic headings

name: test_comments_and_docstrings_are_english
what: Comments and docstrings under mem/, tools/, tests/ and migrations/ have no Cyrillic; string data may
closes: #17, code comments and docstrings are in English (CONTRIBUTING)

name: test_dates_formats
what: Dates "30.09", "05.10.2026", "2026-09-15" and Russian "1 October" are extracted as (day, month) pairs

name: test_numbers_ignore_dates
what: Dates are not counted as numbers, and "2,50" becomes "2.5"

name: test_g2_pass
what: a summary whose dates, numbers and names all occur in the sources passes without violations

name: test_g2_date_distortion
what: a summary where the source date "30.09" became "by October 1" is rejected by condition a

name: test_g2_invented_number_and_name
what: an invented number in a summary violates condition a, an invented surname condition b

name: test_g2_length_kind_language
what: a summary longer than the sources, a non-episode source and a change of language violate conditions c, d and e

name: test_proper_names_sentence_start
what: A function word at the start of a sentence (a preposition) is not a name, but a surname at the start of a sentence is

name: test_schedule_follows_mem_tz
what: Release, operations: the sleep schedule follows the MEM_TZ time zone (UTC by default); deep sleep runs on Sunday

name: test_initial_strength
what: Initial strength depends on importance (0.35 / 0.55 / 0.75); the owner's words add 0.10

name: test_initial_cap
what: Initial strength stays under the 0.90 ceiling even with importance 3 from the owner's words

name: test_reinforce_saturates_and_never_exceeds_1
what: Reinforcements only raise strength towards 1 and never let it exceed 1

name: test_decay_half_life
what: One half-life (30 days) halves the strength exactly: 0.8 -> 0.4

name: test_decay_never_increases_property
what: decay never raises strength and never takes it below zero

name: test_frozen_and_no_half_life
what: Kinds without a half-life and frozen records do not decay

name: test_forget_horizon_examples
what: importance 2 without reinforcement drops below 0.08 after about N days

name: test_repeat_is_weaker_than_independent
what: five repeats from one source raise strength less than one independent piece of evidence

name: test_split_routes
what: Sleep route: a name without a prefix is Anthropic only; cloud routes are refused (records would go out without masking); "openai:" only for models on the in-perimeter list; an unknown prefix is an error

name: test_check_finds_bad_settings_before_first_call
what: A sleep setup error shows before the first call: no Anthropic key, no router address, a cloud model

name: test_openai_compat_call_and_errors
what: A model inside the perimeter: a request with a tool call, the answer is checked against the schema; the server's response body never gets into the error text; network failures and 503 are retried, then it is an error; an invalid answer is a model error

name: test_router_address_cannot_point_to_cloud_and_schema_is_plain
what: The "in-perimeter" router address cannot be a cloud provider's address (Yandex, Sber, OpenAI, Anthropic and others), whatever model name is on the list; the tool schema for the router has no type lists

name: test_routed_call_goes_to_its_provider
what: The call goes to the client of its route with the model name without the prefix

name: test_languages_cover_the_same_texts
what: English and Russian MCP descriptions have the same set of keys; the English ones have no Cyrillic

name: test_tool_descriptions_follow_language
what: MEM_MCP_LANG picks the language of tool descriptions and instructions; an unknown language means English

name: test_images_by_digest
what: FROM in the Dockerfile and the pgvector image in Compose files and CI carry a digest, so a build tomorrow gets the same Python and the same Postgres

name: test_pip_installs_only_hashed_locks
what: the image and CI install libraries only from lock files and only with hash checking

name: test_lock_matches_requirements
what: every library from requirements*.txt is in the lock file at a version its specifier allows (a bump in requirements without `tools/lock.sh` fails here), and every pinned line has hashes

name: test_direct_grant_and_clearance_cap
what: A personal contributor grant gives read and write, and the classification level is cut by the person's clearance

name: test_group_grant_and_best_role
what: Group and organization grants add up: the best role and the highest classification level win

name: test_ceiling_limits_rights_and_namespaces
what: The token ceiling cuts rights even for the owner, and a namespace outside the ceiling is closed entirely

name: test_tenant_mismatch_expired_inactive_missing
what: No access if the namespace belongs to another organization, the grant expired, the person is inactive or the namespace is missing

name: test_local_admin_bypass
what: The local administrator gets the admin right and level 3 without grants and in any organization

name: test_evidence_trusted
what: the owner's words and the work of own clients (dev, session) are trusted, other chats and the web are not

name: test_sanitize_invisible_bidi_tags
what: invisible characters, bidi overrides and Unicode tags are cut out with the finding removed:invisible

name: test_sanitize_ansi_and_control
what: ANSI sequences and control characters are cut out with the findings removed:ansi and removed:control

name: test_sanitize_mixed_script_flag_keeps_text
what: a word mixing Cyrillic and Latin letters gets the mixed-script flag, and the text is not changed

name: test_sanitize_encoded_readable
what: a readable command hidden in base64 or hex gets the encoded flag

name: test_sanitize_loyal_corpus
what: honest texts (hashes, data URIs, code, mixed names, versions) pass without findings or changes

name: test_find_secret
what: Anthropic, AWS, GitHub, Slack, Telegram and JWT keys and private keys are recognized by their shape

name: test_no_false_secret
what: mentions of key prefixes, a path to keys and long numbers are not taken for a secret

name: test_kin_forward_and_copypaste
what: a forward, a copy-paste in another case and the same text with extra spaces count as related

name: test_kin_distinct_texts
what: a retelling in other words, short matches and an empty quote do not count as related

name: test_independent_groups
what: evidence with one key or a related text merges into one independent group

name: test_weights_sum_to_one
what: The weights of the ranking formula (meaning, words, strength, prior) sum to 1

name: test_deterministic_and_tiebreak
what: result order does not depend on candidate order; with an equal score the newer record wins, then the smaller id

name: test_strength_breaks_equal_relevance
what: with equal relevance the record with more strength, that is more confirmations, ranks higher

name: test_lex_zero_when_no_match
what: Without a word match lex is 0 even with high semantic similarity; the only match gives 1

name: test_explain_fields
what: the score breakdown has id, total and the components sem, lex, strength, prior, and nothing else

name: test_every_test_has_description
what: Every test has a docstring saying what it checks
closes: the test registry grows together with the code (CONTRIBUTING, the rule about tests)

name: test_registry_is_up_to_date
what: docs/tests.json and docs/tests.md match the test code: after a new test, run python3 tools/test_catalog.py
closes: the test registry grows together with the code (CONTRIBUTING, the rule about tests)
